mentions.name: Portable desk cloud chamber
mentions.description: A portable, robust desk cloud chamber with a 10x10cm viewing plate, built with an AIO cooler and designed to be vibration-resistant for car transportation and to last years of use.
mentions.problem: Building it to be vibration-resistant for car transportation and durable for years made the project much harder than expected, and fitting the cooling with a single AIO cooler was a constraint.
mentions.source_excerpt: A portable, robust desk cloud chamber with a 10x10cm viewing plate. It's taking ages and having just one AIO cooler wasn't the smartest choice, but nothing else would've fit.
